Purpose: One decision per guide game for the loaders that run a program (not a ROM set): what TPM does for the game, and why. Read by the coverage tool. TPM itself does not read this file.

Scope.Rows: Every top-level guide entry whose loader is not in ExcludedLoaders.
Scope.ExcludedBecause: ROM-set loaders: the guide text for these is "which ROM or disc to select", covered by the ROM family decisions.
Scope.RegisterOnlyBecause: Added in TeknoParrot 1.0.0.2337. TPM registers these games like any other game and adds no patch, file check or setup step for them. TeknoDOS mixes .EXE programs and ROM-set files, so these loaders are not put in the ROM-set list above. No per-game decision is recorded.
Scope.Versions: The guide has nested versions only under the excluded loaders, so no row here has a parent.

Dispositions.not-supported: The guide marks the game unsupported, broken or no longer used. Listed with the reason; TPM cannot make it work.
Dispositions.tpm-applies-patch: A reviewed patch is in scripts/TpmRequiredPatchRecipes.json. Applied only on an exact profile and hash match, with a backup and a receipt.
Dispositions.tpm-checks-files: TPM checks the emulator startup files and copies them only from the player's own archive (PCSX2x6, Chihiro/CxbxR, RPCS3, Play!).
Dispositions.needs-own-archive: The guide names extra archives the player must own. Game Notes lists them. Never downloaded.
Dispositions.tpm-warns: TPM already warns: a graphics card the game does not work on, a path length limit, or a required file version.
Dispositions.guided: Game Notes shows the guide text for the game once it is registered: notes, setup steps, second file, test program, linked profile, graphics card notes.
Dispositions.register-only: Nothing beyond registration is listed in the guide.

Rules: Disposition is the first of these that applies, in this order: not-supported, tpm-applies-patch, tpm-checks-files, needs-own-archive, tpm-warns, guided. register-only when none applies.
Also lists the other dispositions that apply, in the same order.

Signals: unsupported, ignored-entry, broken (not-supported); recipe; emulator-files; supp_archives, additional_archives; gpu-warning, path-limit, file-version (tpm-warns); notes, general_issues, setup_exe2, test_exe, linked_profile, gpu-text (guided); status-partial, status-untested (information only).
Nothing in the guide text is executed. A fix text becomes an applied change only through a reviewed recipe or an existing profile-field helper.
